bonds_intro_1: Ma bondi a boma nthawi zambiri amatchedwa chikayikidwe chopanda chiwopsezo ndipo amaonedwa ngati malo otetezeka kwambiri osungira chuma.
bonds_intro_2: Bitcoin ndi ndalama zadigitala zomwe zimagwira ntchito modziyimira popanda boma kapena olamulira alikulu.
bonds_intro_3: Koma kodi ma bondi ndi opanda chiwopsezo kwenikweni? Ndipo amasiyana bwanji ndi Bitcoin ngati malo osungira chuma? Tiyeni tiwunike kusiyana kwakukulu pakati pa Bitcoin ndi ma bondi a boma.
bonds_point_2: Amatayirira mtengo chifukwa cha kukwera kwa mitengo
point_1_summary_1: Mabondi ndi 'opanda ngozi' pofotokoza basi — kukwera kwa mitengo, kusintha kwa chiwongolero, ndi ngozi ya kulephera zonse zimadya phindu lenileni.
point_1_summary_2: Bitcoin ili ndi kusinthasintha komveka koma palibe ngozi yobisika ya munthu wina.
point_2_summary_3: kuposa phindu la mabondi, eni mabondi amataya mphamvu yogula yenileni chaka chilichonse. Malire a 21 miliyoni a Bitcoin sangakwere.

point_3_summary_3: kumachitikira ndi chifukwa chake Bitcoin imapewa. Bitcoin imagulitsidwa 24/7 padziko lonse popanda zovuta zandalama.
point_4_summary_1: Misika ya Treasury ikhoza kulephera pamene palibe ogula okwanira — onani
point_4_summary_3: Mtengo wa Bitcoin umapezeka mosalekeza pa misika yotseguka popanda msika wapakatikati womwe ungalephere.
point_5_summary_1: Phindu la mabondi limakhazikitsidwa pamene agulidwa. Ngakhale chuma chikwere kapena ndalama zigwe, phindu lanu likhalabe lomwelo.
point_5_summary_2: Bitcoin ili ndi malo akukula kwambiri pamene kugwiritsidwa ntchito kukukula ndipo kufuna kukukumana ndi kuchuluka kokhazikika.
point_6_summary_1: Mabondi ambiri amasungidwa kudzera m'mabanki kapena ma broker, owonjezera ngozi ya munthu wina. Bitcoin imatha kusungidwa nokha ndi
point_7_summary_1: Mabondi amadalira kwathunthu maboma kuti abweze. Ngati boma lilephera kapena lichotse ngongole yake mwa kukwera kwa mitengo, eni mabondi amataya.
point_7_summary_2: Bitcoin imagwira ntchito mwapayekha popanda boma kapena ulamuliro wandale.
